title: fix(ui): the record form's edit dialog reads the record's field projection
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBFrHTwT2queiHnTbzxnSn3Y)_

Fixes #26594
Fixes #27147

Ruling-ref: 6457467702
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: updated here — content/docs/permissions/field-level-security.mdx (the record-scoped projection bullet now says the answer is field-level only and a row the caller may read but not write is refused as a whole); skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md names no reader of the lock, so no skills/** edit (this PR is not governed)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:记录表单的编辑对话框(console 的 `ModalForm`、`ObjectForm` 及其全部布局、`DrawerForm`)在编辑已存在的记录时,向服务端询问「这条记录」的字段投影(#27063 的 `GET /data/{object}/{id}/field-access`),只禁用该答案锁定的字段;保存时外发闸读同一个答案。
- 为什么改:裁决 B。带 `when` 的字段锁(批准后锁定)在草稿上服务端允许写,但表单只读无行的 `/auth/me/permissions`,在草稿上也把字段禁用了。
- 风险与回滚:只替换「字段级锁」这一项输入;对象授权兜底、owner 转移、read/create、其它对象都沿用原答案;答案未到或无答案(404/501/拒绝)时保持原锁;客户端从不求值 `when`。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`ui/packages/permissions/src/RecordFieldAccessScope.tsx`、`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/recordFieldAccess.tsx`、`ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts` 的 `getRecordFieldAccess`。
- 两分钟验证:`cd ui && npx vitest run packages/plugin-form/src/recordFieldAccess-26594.test.tsx`,预期 10/10(草稿上 summary 可编辑且随保存发送,ref_no 与已批准行上的 summary 保持锁定)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**The edit dialog asks for this record's projection.** `RecordFieldAccessForForm` (`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/recordFieldAccess.tsx`) wraps the three containers a record form is rendered through directly: `ModalForm` (the console's edit dialog, mounted by `AppContent`), `ObjectForm` (the `/record/:id/edit` page and every layout it dispatches to, master-detail header included) and `DrawerForm`. Only an `edit` form with an object and a record id, on a data source that has `getRecordFieldAccess`, asks. A container nested in another for the same record reuses the outer answer (asked once).

**One input replaced, nothing evaluated client-side.** `RecordFieldAccessScope` (`@object-ui/permissions`) re-provides the permission context below the form. For the scoped object, `checkField(object, field, 'write')` answers `editable.includes(field)` only where `/auth/me/permissions` reports an explicit field-level lock (the reader that holds no row, which serves a `when`-conditioned entry as its lock). Every other input keeps the enclosing answer: a field with no lock entry (the object-grant fallback), the owner field (a transfer needs a grant the projection does not carry), `read` and `create`, and every other object. Until the answer arrives, and when there is none, the row-blind lock stands, so a conditioned field shows locked rather than briefly open. `gateFormFields`, `applyFieldPermissions` and the outbound `fieldWriteGate` all ask `usePermissions()`, so what the dialog draws and what its save sends read the same answer. The derived value is cached in a module-level `WeakMap` keyed on the enclosing value and the answer (the `ServerReadScope` shape), never a `useMemo` (AGENTS.md #10).

**Adapter.** `DataSource.getRecordFieldAccess?(resource, id)` and the `RecordFieldAccess` type in `@object-ui/types`; `ObjectStackAdapter.getRecordFieldAccess` calls `client.data.fieldAccess`. The record read's 404 and a server without the route (501 `NOT_IMPLEMENTED`) resolve to `null`; any other refusal is thrown.

**Measured: `editable` on a row the caller may read but not write.** The projection is field-level only: the object grant and the record's row-level write scope (sharing, RLS, ownership) are not in it, and the response schema already says so (`GetRecordFieldAccessResponseSchema.editable`, #27063). The new dogfood leg pins it on a real stack: a `public_read` row another user owns answers `GET` 200, `field-access` lists `title` and `summary` editable, and `PATCH title` answers 403. **The ui does not gate the dialog on record-level edit permission anywhere.** The form-wide lock (`managedModeLocked` / `gateFormFields` in `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/fieldWriteGate.ts`) reads the managed bucket, `apiOperations` and `can(object, 'update')`, which is the object grant only. On such a row the dialog therefore offers its fields and the server refuses the save as a whole, exactly as before this PR (the projection never widens it: on that row the row-blind lock was the only field input it replaces). This PR says so where a reader looks: the route's schema (already), `RecordFieldAccess.editable` in `@object-ui/types`, the `RecordFieldAccessScope` doc, and the field-level-security doc's projection bullet. Gating the dialog on row write scope would need a record-level `canEdit` from the server; that is filed as #27138.

**Other surfaces keep their current reader.** Surfaces that hold one row and still read the row-blind answer: the record detail page's inline edit (`plugin-detail` `DetailSection.tsx:507` and `HeaderHighlight.tsx:211`, through `resolveFieldAffordance('recordEdit', …)`), filed as #27146. Surfaces that hold many rows decide per column, not per row: list/grid inline edit (`plugin-grid` `objectGridPersistedColumns.ts:89`, `resolveFieldAffordance('listInlineEdit', …)`). Surfaces that hold no stored row: the new-record form (create mode asks nothing) and `view` forms (write nothing).

Files:

- `ui/packages/permissions/src/RecordFieldAccessScope.tsx` (new), exported from `index.ts`.
- `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/recordFieldAccess.tsx` (new); `ObjectForm.tsx`, `ModalForm.tsx`, `DrawerForm.tsx`: each exported component wraps its unchanged body.
- `ui/packages/types/src/data.ts`, `index.ts`: `RecordFieldAccess`, `DataSource.getRecordFieldAccess?`.
- `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts`: the adapter method.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/fixtures/record-field-access-fixture.ts`, `record-field-access-when.dogfood.test.ts`: the `rfa_notice` (`public_read`) object and the row-not-writable measurement.
- `content/docs/permissions/field-level-security.mdx`: one sentence on the projection's scope.
- Changesets: `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/data-objectstack`, `@object-ui/permissions` (patch, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`), `@object-ui/plugin-form` (patch, `Clause-②: no`), all `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- Round 2 (#27147, claimed for this branch in comment 6464455969): the projection follows the stored row. `RecordFieldAccessScope` takes a `revision`; when it moves, the scope asks again and holds the row-blind lock until the new answer lands. `RecordFieldAccessForForm` moves it on the data-invalidation bus for the record (the signal the form re-reads on) and on the data source's `onMutation` for the record (the form's own save, with or without the console's bridge). Two new tests: `recordFieldAccess-26594.test.tsx` "a save that moves the row into the state the condition names locks the field again" (both containers, so the file is 12; with the revision wiring ablated these 2 go red) and `RecordFieldAccessScope-26594.test.tsx` "a new revision asks again and holds the lock until the new answer lands" (the file is 8). The `@object-ui/permissions` and `@object-ui/plugin-form` changesets each gain one sentence on it.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/recordFieldAccess-26594.test.tsx` (12): for the console's edit dialog (`ModalForm` rendered directly) and for `ObjectForm`'s edit page, under `MePermissionsProvider` with the contract persona (`summary` locked from `approved` onward, served row-blind as a lock; `ref_no` locked on every row):
  - on the draft shape the gate admits, `summary` is live and `ref_no` locked, and the projection is asked once with `('rfa_contract', 'c1')`;
  - the save sends the edited `summary` and withholds `ref_no`;
  - on the approved row both stay locked;
  - a create form asks nothing; a data source without the method keeps the row-blind lock.
- `ui/packages/permissions/src/__tests__/RecordFieldAccessScope-26594.test.tsx` (8): the truth table above, case-insensitive object match, owner/read/create/other object unchanged, empty answer, pending / `null` / rejected answer keeps the lock, nested scope asks once, no provider asks nothing.
- `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/getRecordFieldAccess-26594.test.ts` (4): URL and encoding, envelope unwrap, 404 → `null`, 501 → `null`, 403 thrown.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/record-field-access-when.dogfood.test.ts`: the new measurement leg above (8/8 with #27063's seven).

## Acceptance notes

- The dialog test is the ui half of the card's acceptance ("the edit dialog on hotclm's draft shape enables the fields the gate admits"): the draft/approved projections it feeds are the shapes #27063's dogfood file reads off the real route for the same persona.
- The dogfood suite is not on the PR's CI path; its run is recorded under Verification.
- The row-not-writable gap this PR measures (the dialog never asks whether the row itself is writable, so on a row the PATCH refuses as a whole it still offers the fields and the save answers 403) is tracked as #27138. This PR neither causes nor widens it.

## Verification

Head `90f1ea4df`, one commit on `origin/main` `a98daf75f`.

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 93 derived families, each run and its exit recorded; `--ran` reconciliation: 93 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. 92 exited 0 on the first run. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` exited 1: `check-handler-key-read-sites` found the `view:form` / `object-form` handler reads gone (56 → 51), because the new `ObjectForm` wrapper handed its body the document through `{...props}`, and the census follows a document only through a named `schema=` attribute. The three wrappers now pass `schema={schema}` by name; the census reads 56 again with only line numbers moved, and the gate reran exit 0 (5019 passed). Nothing else changed between the two runs.
- Under `os-verify-lock`: the ui build of every dependency of `@object-ui/plugin-form` and `@object-ui/data-objectstack` exit 0; type-check of `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/permissions`, `@object-ui/data-objectstack`, `@object-ui/plugin-form` exit 0 (plugin-form rerun after the wrapper fix, exit 0); `@object-ui/permissions` test 158 passed, `@object-ui/data-objectstack` test 1209 passed, `@object-ui/plugin-form` test 2423 passed (rerun after the wrapper fix: 204 files, 2423 passed).
- The plugin-form write census (`affordanceGrantMap-12082.test.tsx`) keys write sites by enclosing function: the `ModalForm` / `DrawerForm` `handleSubmit` rows moved to `ModalFormBody` / `DrawerFormBody`, same disposition.
- Dogfood, under `os-verify-lock`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/record-field-access-when.dogfood.test.ts` 8/8; dogfood typecheck exit 0.
- Ablation: with `RecordFieldAccessForForm` forced to pass through, `recordFieldAccess-26594.test.tsx` goes 6 red / 4 green (in both containers: the draft unlock, the save, and the approved row, which waits for the ask); restored (`cmp` identical), 10/10.

[CONTRIBUTING.md › Human Minimum](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#human-minimum),
which links the AGENTS.md text that states it.

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No `packages/spec` change.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [ ] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (No formatter ran. `pnpm lint` is CI's run.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (The 维护者速读 block is in Chinese by the repo's dispatch rule.)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
